title: THE WORLD'S
10 TALLEST
WATERFALLS

hook.say: The ten tallest waterfalls on Earth, ranked. Niagara doesn't even come close!

outro.say: Which one is on your bucket list? Comment below!

outroLines: WHICH ONE IS ON YOUR LIST?

items.name: Browne Falls
items.say: Number ten: Browne Falls, pouring straight into a fjord. 836 meters.
items.cap: Number ten: Browne Falls, pouring straight into a fjord. 836 meters.

items.name: James Bruce Falls

items.name: Pu'uka'oku Falls

items.say: And number one: Angel Falls, Venezuela! 979 meters, nearly a kilometer high.
